Wrap option disabled preserves long lines without breaking

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>This is a long paragraph that should not be wrapped at all because wrapping is disabled.</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(wrap: false))
puts result.content.inspect
```
